## Summary

Completes deterministic first-release Editor Visual Validation for ADR0136, ADR0137, ADR0138, ADR0139, ADR0144, ADR0149, and ADR0153 on current main.

This follow-up preserves the existing base suite while propagating the authoring-tool identity to every independent ADR capture and expanding the ADR0136 residency evidence surface so required lifecycle text is not clipped.

Supersedes Draft PR #774 and the older #673 implementation branch; do not merge both.
